title: What does it return?
hints: A conditional type `T extends Shape ? A : B` can *match* T against a pattern — and `infer` lets you name a piece of that pattern.
The pattern you want is "any function, whatever its parameters": `(...args: any[]) => ...`. Put `infer R` where the return type goes.
type MyReturnType<T extends (...args: any[]) => any> = T extends (...args: any[]) => infer R ? R : never;
